entries.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile for a Spring Boot service built with Maven. Build stage: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17 — copies pom.xml and mvnw, runs mvnw -DskipTests package. Runtime stage: eclipse-temurin:17-jre — copies compiled JAR, exposes 8080, ENTRYPOINT java -jar /app/app.jar.
decision_rules: Multi-stage separates build tools from the runtime image, significantly reducing final image size
Use eclipse-temurin:17-jre (JRE only, not JDK) in runtime stage
tradeoffs: Build time is longer due to Maven dependency resolution, mitigated by caching pom.xml separately
mvnw wrapper must exist in project root; fall back to mvn if absent
anti_patterns: Do not use a JDK image in the runtime stage — use JRE to minimize attack surface
Do not skip -DskipTests if test failures should gate the build
